body:
Found the upstream transcript (misleadingly named LeetCode Skills Course Curriculum.pdf), named its escalation into a multi-year live-service catalog, proposed a real buildable V0 cut. Audited PARENA's real C (mature) vs Java (v0/scalar-only, SPIDERBEETLE is its only precedent) emitter maturity against the 'build it with PARENA, 1 client for Android+Windows like Hearthstone' ask -- not real capability today, recommended two native shells sharing a server instead. Named guest-account auth as genuinely new IDUNA work (only google/iduna_local providers exist today). Pointed at EOSUI-NORTH (not yet built) as the real 'meta UI framework' referenced. DEADWEIGHT 29fda86 (CLAUDE.md + NORTHSTAR.md), MONOREPO 2781667ff (repo table row), EMILY 5d726ac8 (golden-index + BACKLOG S371). No game code yet -- D1 (local core loop) is the next real item.

⚓ ☃
